inventory.visualPurpose: The two-column zero-order / first-order elimination text block (book 230)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE TEXT (pdfimages: zero raster images; VLM confirmed): the two-column elimination block — Zero-order elimination [Rate of elimination is constant regardless of Cp (ie, constant amount of drug eliminated per unit time); Cp ↓ linearly with time; Examples of drugs—Phenytoin, Ethanol, and Aspirin (at high or toxic concentrations → ↑ salicylate saturation → zero-order elimination); Capacity-limited elimination.; margin mnemonic “A PEA is round, shaped like the “0” in zeroorder.”] vs First-order elimination [Rate of first-order elimination is directly proportional to the drug concentration (ie, constant fraction of drug eliminated per unit time); Cp ↓ exponentially with time; Applies to most drugs.; Flow-dependent elimination.].
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual's fork banner + mirror panel headers/markers (EliminationKineticsMap in visuals/pharm-p4.tsx) + blocks[1] the table block carried verbatim

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: The two vector elimination-curve figures (book 230): zero-order (constant 2 U/h, shrinking t1/2 brackets) and first-order (halving 4→2→1→0.5 U/h slopes, equal t1/2 brackets)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: VECTOR LINE ART, no raster (pdfimages: zero raster images; labels read via the pdftotext text layer + VLM): FIGURE 1, Zero-order elimination — y-axis 'Drug plasma concentration ↑', x-axis 'Time (h)', a STRAIGHT declining line with constant slope chips '2 U/h' and an 'Elimination rate (=slope)' label, half-life brackets 'First t1/2 > Second t1/2 > Third t1/2' (VLM: the FIRST bracket, at the highest concentration, is drawn longest), annotation 'Time of t1/2 ↑ as concentration ↑'. FIGURE 2, First-order elimination — same axes, an EXPONENTIAL decay curve whose 'Elimination rate (=slope)' chips halve 4 U/h → 2 U/h → 1 U/h → 0.5 U/h, equal brackets 'First t1/2 = Second t1/2 = Third t1/2', annotation 'Time of t1/2 is constant as concentration ↑'.
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual's two mirror panels (the straight line with 2 U/h chips and shrinking First>Second>Third brackets; the exponential curve with 4→2→1→0.5 U/h chips and equal First=Second=Third brackets) plus the saturation-crossover panel (EliminationKineticsMap in visuals/pharm-p4.tsx)
